bindings.label: Climate reporting

source.title: Climate reporting
source.text: Reviewed FCA rules cover specified listed issuers from accounting periods starting January 2027. First reporting is in 2028; reliefs matter.
source.question: Banking & Aviation · test reporting-data and control needs with the exact issuer.
source.counter: FCA final rules introduce comply-or-explain UK SRS reporting for specified listing categories, for accounting periods starting from 1 January 2027. This is UK relevance of a wider theme, not global prevalence or verified company impact.
